The '''Sandtusker''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used by a [[Unidentified platoon|platoon]] in the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Thirty-eighth Infantry]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Sandtusker was named after the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Sandtusker|scavenger of the same name]] from the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of many of the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon's]] members, and it carried the platoon safely through some of the war's fiercest battles.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sandtusker was first mentioned in the Codex entry for sandtuskers in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
